**Kin-CRM -- a calm, self-hosted personal relationship manager / personal CRM.**
Kin is a personal CRM built for neurodivergent brains (AuDHD, ADHD, autism, RSD, social anxiety, overwhelm): remember your people, not the pressure. Search for it as "Kin", "Kin-CRM" or "personal crm".
**Features:** People and relationship tracking with rich profiles, journaling with energy-cost tracking, conflict resolution with AI-assisted support chat, gentle check-in nudges, gamification with achievements, Immich photo integration, web push notifications, full JSON/CSV export and import, PWA support.
**Tech:** FastAPI + SQLite (default) or optional PostgreSQL. Runs as a single Docker container on Unraid.
Built by Skye, a trans woman in Brisbane, Australia. MIT licensed.
